name: relative-weeks
why: No start date: index 0 is Week 1, day 1 (a Monday), Mon-Fri working, no holidays, and no dates are returned. A calendar lag still counts the weekend: a ends on day 5 (a Friday), its finish instant is Saturday, + 3 days = Tuesday of week 2 = index 6. Working week 0 means the default.

a.why: b's latest start is Tuesday of week 2; minus 3 days = Saturday of week 1; the last 5-day finish with instant on or before that Saturday is 5. LF 5.

b.why: Index 6 is Tuesday of week 2; EF 9 = PF.
